en: Vintage monochrome postcard view of a river scene with a paddle steamer on the Elbe River, low hills and cultivated fields in the background, and a sandy riverbank in the foreground where people, carts, and horses are present. The steamer is emitting smoke from a central funnel and bears writing on its paddle housing. At the top left, there is a printed caption in red indicating the location along the Elbe.
